verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs say self-hosting runs the complete platform on your own infrastructure. They also document Docker setup for a full environment and Kubernetes/OpenShift deployment with Helm charts and operators, and the Edge Proxy is likewise self-hostable. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, explicit evidence of open-source licensing or feature parity between self-hosted and cloud editions.
